subject: Create ONE NEW reusable isolated whole round-canopy tree sprite, using Image 1 as the approved STYLE AND SPECIES reference. Image 1 is a finished riverside scene: do NOT reproduce the scene or cut out pixels. Draw an original standalone tree that closely resembles the compact round tree immediately to the RIGHT of the lamp: clipped but softly irregular compact round crown, broad full silhouette, 3–5 subtly overlapping large leafy clusters across its side, darker calm upper crown and sparse grouped foliage marks in the lower crown. A SHORT forked brown trunk is clearly visible beneath the crown, with two small root toes. Crown occupies about 78 percent of the tree height. Width:height near 100:118. No side views, no extra variants, no occlusion. This tree will be lit dynamically in a game, so the image is MATERIAL ALBEDO: neutral dim blue-green and olive-green foliage, natural umber trunk; no yellow lamplight or bright highlight baked into the tree. The crown must read as rounded but not as a perfect geometric circle, not a bush without a trunk. Match the reference's broad connected pixel clusters, compact texture density and one-to-two ORIGINAL-pixel dark ink contour. Design at a TRUE native resolution about 100 by 118 pixels; display those deliberately placed square pixels enlarged without smoothing. Aim for fewer than 20 coherent colors. High fixed oblique game camera like the reference, tree facing the viewer. Center the whole tree, roots included, with a large margin. The entire background must be one completely flat pure vivid magenta #ff00ff, a removable chroma key. NO ground plane, no cast shadow, no reflection, no glow, no mist, no grass, no labels, no checkerboard, no white matte, no partial tree. Solid opaque tree interior. This is a game asset drawing, NOT another landscape concept painting.
